description: Window cleaning in Austin Lake Estates and Austin Lake Hills. Pure water glass at $10 per window for older homes and new rebuilds near Lake Austin.
h1: Window cleaning in Austin Lake Estates
intro: Austin Lake Estates and Austin Lake Hills are older lakeside subdivisions off Cuernavaca Drive, where original homes and new rebuilds sit side by side. CleanzATX cleans windows for both, and we price each by its size.

sections.h2: What Austin Lake Estates homes are like
paragraphs: These neighborhoods date to the 1960s and 70s, and many of those homes are now being rebuilt. The rows show several hundred homes, prices from about $700K to $2M, and lake access through a community park. Two associations cover the area, Austin Lake Estates and the Lake Hills Community Association.
That mix is the main thing to know. One street can have a mid century ranch with original aluminum windows next to a brand new modern build with floor to ceiling glass.

sections.h2: What Austin Lake Estates windows deal with
paragraphs: Old aluminum frames and tracks collect oxidation, dirt and spider webs. Original glass has lived through decades of sprinkler water, so mineral staining is common and sometimes etched. New builds have the opposite problem: large panes, construction dust inside tracks, and film left from stickers and plaster work.

Lake spray and humidity near the water leave a light film on west facing glass, and in afternoon sun it shows. We clean with water near 0 TDS so the finish is clear, and we treat hard water marks at $10 per pane.

sections.h2: How we work Austin Lake Estates
paragraphs: We quote older homes with a closer look at the glass condition, and we ask for photos. For a new build, we work from the final clean standpoint, removing construction dust from glass and tracks and leaving the windows ready for move in. There is no gate, so we can often combine several homes on a street into one day.
A 2,500 square foot home is about $250 for exterior windows at $0.10 per sq ft. Exterior time is about two to two and a half hours, and interior is about an hour and fifteen minutes by hand.

why: Older aluminum tracks and screens get cleaned along with the glass.
New builds get post construction dust removed from panes and tracks.
Lake spray and west sun film are handled with pure water.
No gate means you can usually be scheduled within two weeks.

faq.q: Do you clean the original windows in a 1960s home?
faq.a: Yes. We check glass condition first, since old panes can be etched by mineral buildup. Anything that can be cleaned is, and we tell you honestly where marks are permanent.

faq.q: Can you clean up after a rebuild?
faq.a: Yes. We clean glass, screens and tracks of construction dust and residue. Inside and out is $15 per window, and screens and tracks are $5 each.

faq.q: What does a typical home cost?
faq.a: Outside glass is $10 per window or about $0.10 per sq ft, so 2,500 square feet is near $250. The $200 minimum applies to smaller jobs, and quotes come by text.

faq.q: Does lake spray cause spots on windows?
faq.a: Water near a lake can leave white mineral film on glass, especially on west walls. Pure water cleaning removes it, and hard water spot removal is $10 per pane for the stubborn marks.

faq.q: Is this area in your service range?
faq.a: Yes. We cover the Bee Cave Road corridor and Lake Austin side neighborhoods from Lakeway. Text your address and we confirm, along with a quote within the hour in business hours.
